bio: Take delight in a visit to Barnsdale Gardens in Leicestershire. A beautiful masterpiece created by Geoff Hamilton, there are 38 individual gardens for you to explore.  This is the ideal day out for gardening enthusiasts and those keen to admire the beauty of nature. After a meander around, take a seat in The Helenium Tea Rooms.  You will be treated to a traditional afternoon tea for two. Enjoy a selection of dainty sandwiches, mini sweet treats and fluffy scones topped with clotted cream and jam, all served on beautiful bone china. Share a pot of tea or coffee as you catch up over this indulgent treat.
